task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with a player-facing upgrade-choice hierarchy, a complete ordinary five-wave run/restart path, restored authored cemetery spatial integrity and external depth, and bounded dense-profile instrumentation for host qualification.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three product surfaces: the authored cemetery's playable datum, external-depth presentation, and landmark visibility are still mismatched under the shipped camera; the ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper state route remains unverified; and dense native qualification is an environment-gated evidence gap rather than a local gameplay defect.

stop_conditions: Stop after focused candidate implementation and code/static checks for the three bounded tasks; Tester and GameLoop Runtime own runtime recapture, formal verdicts, and issue closure.
Do not replace the preserved authored cemetery package or spend product scope on unavailable native-renderer qualification beyond bounded instrumentation.

strategy.rationale: Use distinct root-cause treatments: repair the run transaction and real upgrade-draft presentation, restore world geometry/bindings through native rendered bounds and occlusion isolation instead of another camera transform tweak, and keep dense profiling as release-guarded instrumentation only.

code: Run focused Godot script/parser checks on modified world, lifecycle, UI, and dense-profile files; verify project configuration and release guards introduce no errors.
Run deterministic state checks for wave 1→5, Bellkeeper defeat, Result/Retry exactly-once behavior, reset isolation, draft eligibility/debounce, and authoritative upgrade mutation.
runtime: Tester/GameLoop Runtime replays an ordinary five-wave Bellkeeper run with real movement and automatic combat, then captures Result and three clean retries.
Tester recaptures cemetery spawn, critical route, four cardinal interior-street, landmark approach/departure, perimeter, collision, and mouse yaw/pitch evidence.
Host executes the dense prepare→advance→reset protocol for three native-renderer cycles at the required density/resolution and preserves boot/native baseline checks.
visual: Inspect the upgrade page at the configured native viewport and supported UI scale for silhouettes/icons, compact current-to-new deltas, restrained copy, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states.

Inspect gameplay frames for larger traversable scale, coherent external world depth, central landmark visibility, collision-aligned traversal, readable escape lanes, and absence of west-perimeter void or landmark disappearance.

done_when: A normal run advances through five data-driven waves, including Bellkeeper transition/defeat, then commits Result exactly once.
Retry or Return to Title creates a fresh run generation with cleared enemies, projectiles, pickups, timers, pause ownership, audio, HUD, boss, and result flags.

The level-up page presents three authored silhouettes/icons with restrained copy, no more than three decision-relevant current-to-new stat deltas per choice, truthful CURRENT values, and distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/selected states.
Selecting a card updates the authoritative build before gameplay resumes and the next relevant combat event visibly reflects the selected upgrade.
Held confirm is debounced and the draft cannot reopen twice for one level threshold.
tasks.instructions: Repair the authoritative RunController/WaveDirector/Bellkeeper transition and reset ownership so ordinary player input, automatic combat, all five waves, Result, and clean Retry are reachable without diagnostic fixtures or synthetic ledger rows. In the same run-shell transaction, revise the real upgrade-draft scene/controller into a bespoke visual hierarchy with authored weapon/upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for at most three deltas, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states. Keep tester-only prepare/advance actions isolated and release-guarded; separate preparation from transition advancement. Add focused state and UI checks for exactly-once victory, reset isolation, draft eligibility, and upgrade application.
